nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are the consequences of continued forest fragmentation in the region?
nodes.answer: Continued forest fragmentation will result in increased edge effects and a greater proportion of forest remaining in an early successional state, leading to a reduced and homogenized assemblage of amphibians and reptiles.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Deforestation prevention|Forest fragmentation mitigation_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What methods were used to determine fragmentation levels for the study?
nodes.answer: Fragmentation levels were determined by comparing historical and contemporary aerial imagery, along with supplementary data.
